name: Rea X Del
source:
"This a dull world"

A world everyone puts on a mask; the one who is somebody and the other who is a nobody.  What if you're able to take that mask off and envelop in a maskless world; to fall under the fantasy or come back?

[From [url=https://leiphory.itch.io/rea-x-del]Itch.io[/url]]
